snippet.title: Your Debt Is Paid - World Premiere Trailer | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Delve deep into monster-filled dungeons to survive a cruel bargain for your life in this dark fantasy roguelike auto-battler. Wield powerful synergies and unique hero combinations to gather Blood from your enemies and satisfy the demands of your mysterious captor.
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
